2. Daily Summary
On October 7, 2026, the interior of the site was clean with no materials on the floor, and DensGlass had been installed on the exterior side of the area where our crew was working. One worker on a boom lift was 100% tied off at all times. Enrique and Jose Favera took their fall protection and ladder training on site, and the workers who took the training showed correct use of their fall protection and how to properly tie off to the lift. Metal framing was neatly stacked by the wall away from walkways, metal scrap was stacked against the wall, and a trash buggy was in use collecting trash around the site. Temporary power was provided by the GC, and extension cords, batteries, the charger and the 3-way outlet were in good condition with no cuts, pinch points or modifications. Gloves and face shield brackets were on site. Two gas cans that are not permitted on site were found and will be removed and replaced immediately. Tools were in good condition with no signs of modification, cold water was provided by the foreman, and the fire extinguisher was in good condition, tagged, with the needle on green.

PPE Supplies — Gloves and face shield brackets on site in the gang box.
